title: Neferine inhibits BMECs pyroptosis and maintains blood-brain barrier integrity in ischemic stroke by triggering a cascade reaction of PGC-1alpha.
authors: Zheng, Zi-Jian; Zhu, Li-Zhi; Qiu, Han; Zheng, Wu-Yin-Xiao; You, Peng-Tao; Chen, Shu-He; Hu, Chun-Ling; Huang, Jun-Rong; Zhou, Ya-Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Neferine通过PGC-1alpha通路抑制细胞焦亡保护血脑屏障，仅涉及分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Blood-brain barrier disruption is a critical pathological event in the progression of ischemic stroke (IS). Most studies regarding the therapeutic potential of neferine (Nef) on IS have focused on neuroprotective effect. However, whether Nef attenuates BBB disruption during IS is unclear. We here used mice underwent transient middle cerebral artery occlusion (tMCAO) in vivo and bEnd.3 cells exposed to oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) injury in vitro to simulate cerebral ischemia. We showed that Nef reduced neurobehavioral dysfunction and protected brain microvascular endothelial cells and BBB integrity. Molecular docking, short interfering (Si) RNA and plasmid transfection results showed us that PGC-1alpha was the most binding affinity of biological activity protein for Nef. And verification experiments were showed that Nef upregulated PGC-1alpha expression to reduce mitochondrial oxidative stress and promote TJ proteins expression, further improves the integrity of BBB in mice. Intriguingly, our study showed that neferine is a natural PGC-1alpha activator and illustrated the mechanism of specific binding site. Furthermore, we have demonstrated Nef reduced mitochondria oxidative damage and ameliorates endothelial inflammation by inhibiting pyroptosis to improve BBB permeability through triggering a cascade reaction of PGC-1alpha via regulation of PGC-1alpha/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling pathway to maintain the integrity of BBB in ischemia/reperfusion injury.
abstract_zh: 血脑屏障破坏是缺血性脑卒中（IS）进展中的关键病理事件。关于莲心碱（Nef）对IS治疗潜力的多数研究集中于神经保护作用。然而，Nef是否减轻IS期间的血脑屏障破坏尚不清楚。我们在此使用体内经历短暂大脑中动脉闭塞（tMCAO）的小鼠和体外暴露于氧糖剥夺/复氧（OGD/R）损伤的bEnd.3细胞来模拟脑缺血。我们表明，Nef减少了神经行为功能障碍，并保护了脑微血管内皮细胞及血脑屏障完整性。分子对接、小干扰（Si）RNA和质粒转染结果显示，PGC-1alpha是Nef生物活性蛋白中结合亲和力最高的靶点。验证实验表明，Nef上调PGC-1alpha表达，以减少线粒体氧化应激并促进紧密连接（TJ）蛋白表达，进一步改善小鼠血脑屏障完整性。有趣的是，我们的研究表明，莲心碱是一种天然的PGC-1alpha激活剂，并阐明了其特异性结合位点的机制。此外，我们已证明，Nef通过调控PGC-1alpha/NLRP3/GSDMD信号通路，触发PGC-1alpha的级联反应，减少线粒体氧化损伤，并通过抑制焦亡改善内皮炎症，从而改善血脑屏障通透性，以维持缺血/再灌注损伤中血脑屏障的完整性。
